SUMMARY.value: Platform for running nginx 1.24 or building nginx-based application

DESCRIPTION.value: Nginx is a web server and a reverse proxy server for HTTP, SMTP, POP3 and IMAP protocols, with a strong focus on high concurrency, performance and low memory usage. The container image provides a containerized packaging of the nginx 1.24 daemon. The image can be used as a base image for other applications based on nginx 1.24 web server. Nginx server image can be extended using source-to-image tool.
